Analysis of Drone Security

How access to a Ryze Tello’s Wi-Fi link affected the pilot’s control and camera privacy in five laboratory tests. The Bulgarian edition includes the extended discussion and five figures from the manuscript.

Martin Stefanov, Milen Petrov and Adelina Aleksieva-Petrova

Conference paper · DOISofia University record2025 journal article

A camera link and a control link

The paper studies a Ryze Tello through its wireless connection to a controller. It maps the system, classifies threats with STRIDE and selects practical tests. The authors report weaknesses affecting access to the local network, continuity of control, camera privacy and the origin of commands.

The distinction matters for design review. A pilot may notice a lost command immediately. Someone else seeing a video stream can be much harder for the pilot to detect. Authentication of the controller, confidentiality of the stream and a defined response to a lost connection are separate engineering requirements.

Scope and publication

The reported behaviour belongs to this device and configuration. Applying a conclusion to a different aircraft would require examining that aircraft’s link, firmware and failure behaviour.

Martin Stefanov, Milen Petrov and Adelina Aleksieva-Petrova published the conference paper in the COMCONF 2024 proceedings, pp. 46–52. A separate 2025 journal record appears in Journal of Electromagnetics, vol. 8, pp. 8–14.

Martin Stefanov
